name: com.achieve.infinity-value
description: Large-number value type for Unity idle and incremental games, with compact unit formatting, parsing, arithmetic, comparison, and optional JSON serialization.

samples.description: Create, format, compare, and calculate InfinityValue values.
Use ScriptableObject content instances to own custom InfinityValue unit names.
Persist InfinityValue strings through PlayerPrefs and parse them safely.

_upm.changelog:
## Added
- Added Pow, Sqrt, Log10, and AffordableCount for idle-game cost-curve math.
- Added SerializableInfinityValue and a custom PropertyDrawer for Unity Inspector editing.
